approve.title: Approve portal listing
approve.description: the company appears on the portal home page wherever its own settings list it. Its admins are told.

reject.title: Reject portal listing
reject.description: the company stays off the portal home page. Its own website keeps working. Its admins are told, with your reason.

verify.title: Mark verified
verify.description: you checked this NIPT/VAT number. The company shows a Verified badge on the portal until its number changes.

unverify.title: Remove verified mark
unverify.description: the company no longer shows the Verified badge on the portal.
